limitations: This is same-input implementation/backend parity only; it does not establish spatial or temporal convergence. Field norms compare the final captured fields, not every transient state or peak-time trajectory.
This case does not match the NIST AMB2022-03 case 0 process conditions or its observation operator; no residual or experimental validation is implied.
The reported 21.996 s is the focused test wall time, not a stage-separated solver benchmark or an end-to-end application speedup.
The test shares CPU source integration and timestep limiting with both CUDA candidates; parity does not compare three independent physical formulations.
Melt geometry is quantized at 40 µm cell resolution; width and depth are one cell and volume is three cells. The allowed 40 µm geometry difference equals 100% of this case's reported width/depth.
Raw CPU/GPU result and field artifacts were not retained; exact scalar values from the in-memory diagnostic rerun cannot be byte-replayed. The unittest assertions remain the PASS evidence.
